title: ExtractRequest
description: A request to extract documents into a load Ingest created.

adjudication.description: Optional model-selected linking. `adjudication.auto` defaults to false.

database.description: The graph written to; one request at a time writes to it.

decisions.description:
Settled review decisions snapshotted for this load: at most 10,000, never truncated.
Two of one identity, a resolve decision without a document or a normalized name, or a
decision giving one of `decision_id` and `decided_at` without the other, refuse the
request; one that no longer fits `ontology_toml` is counted (`totals.stale_decisions`)
and left out, except a resolve decision of a type it has, whose name is reviewed again
rather than matched another way. A value a property decision overwrites keeps the
decision's `decision_id` and `decided_at`, so the load tells when it was decided.

documents.description:
The documents, extracted up to `limits.documents_in_flight` at once and committed one
at a time.

dry_run.description: Read the store but write nothing.

load.description:
The load written to, the backend's current one. Ingest must have created it with
`ontology_version`, and it must not be being deleted; otherwise nothing is written
(`load_unknown`, `load_mismatch`).

mappings_toml.description:
The approved `mappings.toml`. Its `[extractions]` routes give each document set's
scope: what its documents may name, create, fill and link. A document of a set no route
reads is stored with its sections, unread (`out_of_scope`).

models.description:
The models that extract and verify. The endpoint's API key travels in the call's
metadata, never here.

ontology_version.description: The version the graph records, in place of the one `ontology_toml` declares.

request_id.description: The idempotency key: a retry sends the same one.

Adjudication.description:
Optional `ExtractRequest.adjudication`; `auto` is off unless explicitly enabled.
Suggestions are still recorded when it is off.

AwsRegion.description:
An AWS region, such as `us-east-1` or `ap-southeast-2`: its endpoint's host is built from
it, never typed.

AzureEndpoint.description:
An Azure OpenAI resource's endpoint: https on a host of `openai.azure.com`,
`cognitiveservices.azure.com` or `services.ai.azure.com`, with no port, user, query or
fragment, and no path but `/openai/v1`. It is kept as `{origin}/openai/v1`.

CompatApi.description: The OpenAI API an OpenAI-compatible server speaks.

Decision.description:
One settled review: a link choice or a property value, never a mix of the two.
`entity_key` is the stored key encoding for keyed types, the normalized name for named ones.
Either may name the decision, by the backend's `decision_id` and when it was settled
(`decided_at`): both or neither, as one alone is refused. The version of a value a property
decision overwrites keeps them, so a load built since still tells when it was decided.

decided_at.description: When it was settled; given with `decision_id`.

decision_id.description: The decision's id, as the backend keeps it; given with `decided_at`.

decided_at.description: When it was settled; given with `decision_id`.

decision_id.description: The decision's id, as the backend keeps it; given with `decided_at`.

Endpoint.description: The endpoint every model of a request is called on.

call_timeout_secs.description:
One JSON or text call's attempt, from connecting to its last byte, in seconds. Turns
are bounded by the request's wall time and an idle watchdog instead.

max_calls_in_flight.description:
Calls in flight on this endpoint at once, across every request, model and kind of call;
none for no endpoint-wide bound. A local server takes one or a few.

provider.description: Who serves the models, and where.

artifacts.description:
Artifacts of earlier runs, under the files root. Every model call one of them holds
replays, with no cost; only the others are asked, such as the section calls a route's
new property changes.

doc_id.description: The backend's document id, which the graph records it by.

path.description: The text to read, under the files root.

set.description: The document set it belongs to, whose routes give its scope.

uri.description: Where the original is kept, recorded as the document's provenance; never read.

max_text_bytes.description: The largest document text read; a longer one fails `too_large`.

max_usd.description: Spend, in US dollars, checked before every model call.

ExtractModels.description: The models a document's extraction runs on.

verify.description: Judges whether the text states each fact.

HelixTarget.description: Where the graph is written: the backend's proxy for one Helix database.

max_request_bytes.description: The largest request body the proxy takes; a write past it is refused before it is sent.

timeout_secs.description: How long one request may take, in seconds.

token.description: The job's bearer token for the proxy.

LoadId.description: One load of an approved version into a graph: the id of the backend job that creates it, such as a ULID. One or more printable ASCII characters, no space.

MediaType.description:
Document formats that take the LLM path. Tables and code take deterministic routes and are
not documents.

oneOf.description: Markdown: sections break at headings too.

ModelName.description:
A model's name as its provider takes it: 1 to 200 characters, none of them whitespace or a
control character.

ModelSpec.description: What a request runs a role on.

context_tokens.description:
The context window: Ollama's `num_ctx`, elsewhere a bound the prompt is checked
against.

max_output_tokens.description: The most output one response may write, under the task's own ceiling.

name.description:
The model, as the provider names it (an Azure deployment's name, a Bedrock model or
inference profile id).

reasoning.description: Send the provider's reasoning knob (Anthropic's effort, OpenAI's reasoning effort).

revision.description: The Ollama model's digest the request was tested on.

ModelUrl.description:
The base URL of a server the request names: http or https, with a host, and with no user,
password, query or fragment; a path is kept, without a trailing `/`. Whether plain http or
a private address may be called is the server's to say ([`TurnModels::check`]).

OllamaDigest.description: An Ollama model's digest: `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

oneOf.description: The model's row in Helix's price table.

Another model's row of the same provider kind: the model an Azure deployment runs, or
the model behind a Bedrock inference profile.
Nothing: a local or self-hosted model.

Provider.description:
Who serves a request's models, and where. Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Bedrock need
an API key; an Ollama server takes none; an OpenAI-compatible server may.

oneOf.description: An Azure OpenAI resource; each model is a deployment's name.
Amazon Bedrock's runtime in a region, with a Bedrock API key.
A server speaking an OpenAI API.

base_url.description: Its base URL, the version path included, such as `https://llm.example.com/v1`.

Rates.description: Per-token rates, in nano-dollars ($1 per million tokens is 1,000).

cache_read.description: Input read from the provider's prompt cache; the input rate when none.

cache_write.description: Input written to the provider's prompt cache; the input rate when none.

SetId.description: The id of a document set, such as `set_01JDX4K2`: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

Value.description: A scalar property decision. Objects and arrays are refused at the contract boundary.
